text: かいじゅうマニアの　＊が　しょうぶを　しかけてきた！
note: かいじゅう (kaijū) is the word for the giant monsters of Japanese films such as Godzilla, so this is a fan of that kind of monster movie.
claim: Kaijū is the Japanese term for the giant monsters of films such as Godzilla.

check.quote: the term "kaiju" is generally used to specifically refer to the Japanese style of giant monster media. [...] The 1954 film Godzilla is often considered a pioneer of kaiju eiga
